title: Cadence: Adaptive Academic & Exam Orchestrator
tagline: The zero-friction study planner that transforms syllabi into auto-rebalancing daily revision schedules.
executiveSummary: Student productivity apps represent a paradox: demand is perennial and massive, yet app mortality is extraordinarily high due to high manual data entry friction and seasonal churn. Cadence targets the fatal flaw of incumbent tools (Notion, Google Calendar, MyStudyLife)—manual task logging—by implementing multi-modal syllabus ingestion (PDF/OCR) coupled with an automated, dynamic spaced-repetition revision engine. By pivoting away from a passive calendar and toward an active 'academic copilot' that auto-adjusts when a student falls behind, Cadence solves the root cause of abandoned study routines.

strategicPillars.primaryAdvantage: Automated syllabus ingestion via Vision LLM and dynamic workload rebalancing using modified FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) algorithms.
strategicPillars.targetAudiencePillar: High-workload university STEM students and upper-secondary exam students (AP/IB/A-Levels) managing 4+ concurrent complex courses.
strategicPillars.monetizationPath: Freemium B2C model ($4.99/month or $39.99/year) with an institutional parent-gifting flow and campus ambassador referral mechanics.

personas.title: Overwhelmed College Sophomore (STEM Major)
personas.demographics: 19-21 years old, dual engineering/math load, highly digital but runs on fragmented tools.
personas.description: Juggles 5 courses with staggered weekly problem sets, lab reports, and high-stakes midterms. Constantly tracks deadlines in Apple Notes, Google Calendar, and Canvas.
personas.coreFriction: Cramming fatigue and compounding panic; when they miss one scheduled study block, their entire static timetable collapses, forcing them into all-nighters.

personas.title: Anxious High School Senior (AP/IB Candidate)

personas.description: Prepares for 4 simultaneous standardized exams 4 months away while balancing regular daily homework and extracurriculars.
personas.coreFriction: Inability to reverse-engineer long-term exam dates into structured, bite-sized daily revision tasks across disparate subjects.

competitorAnalysis.solutionClass: Generic To-Do & Calendar Apps (Notion, Todoist, Google Calendar)
competitorAnalysis.coreStrengths: Universal platform availability, reliable cloud sync, polished ecosystems.
competitorAnalysis.criticalWeaknesses: Zero academic context; requires exhausting manual input for every subtask; static schedules that break immediately when a deadline slips.
competitorAnalysis.opportunityGap: Build purpose-built academic semantics: course credit weightings, exam-countdown algorithms, and auto-scheduling.

competitorAnalysis.coreStrengths: Academic-first data model (semesters, courses, assignments, professors).
competitorAnalysis.criticalWeaknesses: Clunky dated interfaces, painful initial setup time (1-2 hours per semester), zero dynamic algorithmic rescheduling.
competitorAnalysis.opportunityGap: Instant 60-second course onboarding via syllabus PDF drag-and-drop parsing, coupled with automated buffer-day calculations.

competitorAnalysis.coreStrengths: Zero digital distraction, tactile gratification, complete spatial layout freedom.
competitorAnalysis.criticalWeaknesses: Zero reminder capability, impossible to recalculate when timelines change, static and non-searchable.
competitorAnalysis.opportunityGap: Preserve high-leverage spatial 'week-at-a-glance' cognitive models without the penalty of manual ink rewriting.

marketResearchQuestions: What is the quantitative drop-off rate of student planner apps between Week 1 and Week 4 of an academic semester?
Will students pay directly via app stores ($4.99/mo), or does customer acquisition require parental subsidization/student card billing?
What percentage of course syllabi across US/UK higher education are provided as parseable digital PDFs versus proprietary LMS walled gardens?
Does automated spaced repetition study scheduling improve self-reported student anxiety scores by a measurable margin (>20%)?
Which specific push notification triggers result in task execution rather than notification dismissal among students with ADHD/executive dysfunction?

problemClarity.explanation: Over 80% of secondary and tertiary students experience deadline stress, with the root cause being cognitive overload from manual planning rather than lack of study intent.

willingnessToPay.pricingModel: Freemium with $4.99/mo or $39.99/yr 'Pro Exam Pass' (Targeted at exam crunch windows)
willingnessToPay.details: Students are historically price-sensitive, but spend readily on study accelerators (e.g., Quizlet Plus, Chegg, Notion templates). Providing a free tier for basic task management and gating AI syllabus extraction and auto-rescheduling unlocks high conversion during midterms and finals.

mainAssumptions: Students will trust an AI engine to extract dates accurately from messy, unstructured syllabus documents.
The primary failure point of student organizers is setup friction, not lack of student discipline.
Dynamic auto-rescheduling reduces guilt/abandonment behavior when students miss scheduled study blocks.
potentialUserNeeds: Frictionless 30-second bulk import of semester deadlines.
Proactive notifications that state exactly what to do right now, removing decision paralysis.
Adaptive schedule readjustment that gracefully absorbs skipped days without manual recalculation.

prioritizedRisks.title: Input Abandonment Churn
prioritizedRisks.description: Students download the app with high enthusiasm during syllabus week, but abandon it within 10 days because manual homework entry takes too much effort.
prioritizedRisks.mitigation: Lead product flow with single-click PDF/photo syllabus parsing that pre-populates the entire term's milestone calendar in under 60 seconds.

prioritizedRisks.title: OCR/LLM Hallucination of Critical Exam Dates
prioritizedRisks.description: AI incorrectly parses an exam date or misses an assignment deadline, causing a student to fail an academic requirement and destroying product trust.
prioritizedRisks.mitigation: Implement a mandatory interactive confirmation drawer highlighting parsed dates against the original document snippet before committing to the schedule.

prioritizedRisks.title: Extreme Summer & Break Seasonality
prioritizedRisks.description: User retention and MRR plummet by 60-70% between June and August when university classes are not in session.
prioritizedRisks.mitigation: Annual billing pushed as default default tier; introduce summer project/internship/test prep (GRE, LSAT, MCAT, SAT) transition templates.

smokeTestExperiments.title: Experiment 1: The 'Syllabus to Schedule' Landing Page
smokeTestExperiments.description: Deploy a high-converting landing page offering a free tool: 'Drop your Course Syllabus PDF, get an iCal feed with optimized study blocks'. Run $75 targeted TikTok/Instagram ads targeting college students.
smokeTestExperiments.successCriterion: >25% email capture conversion and >150 syllabus uploads.

smokeTestExperiments.title: Experiment 2: Concierge Manual Dynamic Rescheduling Test
smokeTestExperiments.description: Recruit 20 STEM students on university subreddits (e.g., r/EngineeringStudents). Manually build and maintain their dynamic revision plans via WhatsApp/SMS, rebalancing their schedules when they miss days.
smokeTestExperiments.successCriterion: >70% of participants report meaningful reduction in study anxiety and request continued service.

smokeTestExperiments.title: Experiment 3: Willingness-to-Pay Paywall Test
smokeTestExperiments.description: Embed a mocked '$3.99/month Unlock AI Auto-Rescheduler' paywall inside a free web-based revision schedule generator tool.
smokeTestExperiments.successCriterion: >5% click-to-purchase intent on the mocked checkout screen.

smokeTestExperiments.title: Experiment 4: Direct Campus Channel Viral Loop Test
smokeTestExperiments.description: Post custom pre-made revision schedules for popular university introductory courses (e.g., Biology 101, Calculus I) on targeted university Discord/WhatsApp student groups.
smokeTestExperiments.successCriterion: >100 organic schedule downloads with a >30% invitation referral rate.

specificRecommendations: Never present a wall of red 'Overdue' tasks; automatically classify missed sessions as 'Pending Rebalance' to remove shame-driven churn.
Implement bidirectional standard iCal sync in Phase 1 so students do not need to abandon their existing native calendar apps for social events.
Target high-stakes standardized exam communities (MCAT, A-Levels, AP exams) as initial beachheads due to their hyper-acute willingness to pay.
Ship a friction-free web-first client (PWA) prior to native apps so students can effortlessly paste syllabi during desktop laptop study sessions.

finalProjectPlan.markdownSpecification:
# Cadence — Product Requirements & Architectural Specification

## 1. Executive Summary
Cadence is an intelligent study orchestration engine engineered to eliminate the manual friction of academic planning. By replacing static task lists with dynamic, auto-rebalancing study cadences derived automatically from course syllabi, Cadence prevents student burnout and study abandonment.

## 2. Core Problem & User Dynamics
- **Setup Friction:** Students abandon digital planners because manually transcribing 30+ assignments per class takes hours.
- **The Overdue Death Spiral:** Traditional to-do apps collect red 'Overdue' flags when a student falls sick or takes a day off, causing emotional avoidance and app deletion.
- **Revision Blindness:** Students treat studying as an event occurring 48 hours before an exam rather than a distributed process, resulting in severe sleep deprivation and poor retention.

## 3. Product Architecture & User Flow
1. **Ingestion Layer:** User drags and drops course syllabi (PDF, PNG, or DOCX). A lightweight Gemini 2.5 Flash model parses the documents into a strictly typed schema containing course titles, assignment weights, due dates, and exam dates.
2. **Verification Drawer:** User reviews parsed dates side-by-side with the uploaded document to guarantee 100% schedule fidelity.
3. **Schedule Synthesis:** The Cadence engine calculates backward from exam dates, inserting 45-minute revision blocks using spaced repetition intervals (e.g., T-21 days, T-14 days, T-7 days, T-3 days, T-1 day).
4. **Daily Execution:** The student interacts with a minimal 'Daily Focus' interface displaying only today's mandatory blocks.
5. **Adaptive Rebalancing:** If a study session is missed, tapping 'Rebalance' automatically smooths the missed hours across remaining available study windows without human reconfiguration.

## 4. MVP Functional Scope
- **Auth & Storage:** Supabase Auth (Magic Link / Google OAuth) + PostgreSQL database with strict RLS.
- **Syllabus Parsing API:** Python/FastAPI endpoint leveraging Gemini 2.5 Flash structured outputs.
- **Calendar Engine:** Standard iCalendar (RFC 5545) subscription output URL.
- **Client:** Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, deployable as a mobile-first PWA.

## 5. Monetization & Growth
- **Free Tier:** 2 course syllabi parsed per semester, standard manual task entry, manual schedule adjustments.
- **Pro Tier ($4.99/mo or $39.99/yr):** Unlimited syllabi uploads, automated dynamic rebalancing engine, two-way Google Calendar conflict sync, and priority exam cram-prevention mode.
